purpose: Define the Editor node graph as a typed projection/composition surface over canonical relations, schemas, Events, Triggers, Commands, runners and other Meta wiring, with explicit ports and validated edges.

does_not_own: runtime execution authority unless explicitly referenced

topics.name: Node Graph
topics.purpose: Define the Editor node graph as a typed projection/composition surface over canonical relations, schemas, Events, Triggers, Commands, runners and other Meta wiring, with explicit ports and validated edges.

operations.name: Project semantic content into node graph

semantics.port_rule: Each node may expose any number of typed inputs/outputs.
semantics.connection_rule: Connections are validated against explicit port types and edge semantics.
semantics.content_api_rule: Node content references semantic content definitions; initial content kinds include comment and example.
semantics.projection_rule: Graph position is presentation only and does not create canonical relation/causality.
semantics.semantic_rule: Canonical structural/causal meaning comes from the referenced semantics, not SVG edge styling.
semantics.extension_rule: New node content types require explicit content semantics, not renderer-specific conventions.

invariants.rule: Expose, nanoCMS, MetaModules and Editor remain projections/compositions over canonical semantics and never create hidden runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: SVG edge style creates causal meaning
node content embeds hidden domain semantics
renderer-specific convention required to reconstruct canonical graph meaning

references.purpose: Graph structural edges preserve canonical dimensions.
